description: This file declares functions and structures related to URL parsing, decoding, and handling, including checking if a string is a URL, decoding URL-encoded strings, and appending slashes to URLs.

methods.name: is_url
methods.description: Checks if the provided string is a valid URL.

methods.name: is_urlschemechar
methods.description: Determines if the given character is valid in the URL scheme.

methods.name: url_decode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded sequences in a URL string.

methods.name: url_decode_mem
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string with specified length.

methods.name: url_percent_decode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded sequences before any ':' in the URL.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_name
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded parameter name from the query string.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_value
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded parameter value from the query string.

methods.name: end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Appends a slash to the end of the URL in the strbuf structure.

methods.name: str_end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Creates a new string with a slash appended to the URL.
